title: University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS)
program_type: Higher degree by research scholarship, competitively awarded
duration: 100% tuition fees for up to 14 research periods (delivered by the automatically awarded University of Sydney Tuition Fee Scholarship)
description: The University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS) is a competitively awarded stipend scholarship for international students commencing or already enrolled in a higher degree by research at the University of Sydney. It pays a stipend of $44,293 per annum at the 2027 rate, indexed annually, plus relocation and thesis allowances. Holders are automatically awarded the companion University of Sydney Tuition Fee Scholarship, which covers 100% of tuition fees for up to 14 research periods together with Overseas Student Health Cover, making the combined package a full funding package

title: Deakin International Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship 100% (South Asia)
description: Deakin's Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship recognises international students with consistently high academic performance and the potential to make a leading contribution to Deakin and the communities we serve. It offers 100% or 50% of tuition fees depending on the scholarship outcome, together with participation in the Vice-Chancellor's Professional Excellence Program and priority access to on-campus accommodation.

title: RMIT Future Leaders Scholarship
program_type: Automatic tuition fee reduction scholarship for international students from India and the subcontinent
duration: Duration of the eligible program(s) as outlined in the offer letter
description: The Future Leaders Scholarship is an RMIT University award that gives students from India and the subcontinent a 20% tuition fee reduction for eligible Bachelor and Masters by coursework programs. Applicants must already hold an RMIT offer letter to commence from 2026 intakes onwards in a program that is eligible for the award, and be citizens of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan. title: Flinders International Postgraduate Research Scholarship (FIPRS)
program_type: University-funded international higher degree by research scholarship
duration: 3.5 years for a Research Doctorate degree; up to 2 years for a Research Masters degree
description: The Flinders International Postgraduate Research Scholarship (FIPRS) is a Flinders University-funded award for international students that pays the full international tuition fees for a research higher degree and provides a tax-free stipend of $36,061 per annum at the 2026 rate, paid fortnightly. Up to five scholarships are awarded annually to applicants selected on academic merit and research potential. title: Macquarie International Research Training Program (iRTP)
program_type: Government-funded (Department of Education) international research training scholarship administered by the university
duration: Up to three years for PhD applicants; MRes applicants may be counter-offered entry with a provisional three-year PhD
description: The International Research Training Program (iRTP) is the Australian Government's Research Training Program scholarship scheme for international graduate research students, administered by Macquarie University on behalf of the Department of Education.
